meta.title: Voice-controlled pet
meta.description: Hold the microphone button beside the composer and say one sentence; the dsh-pet companion does it. Say "dance" and it dances, "go to sleep" and it sleeps, "go left" and it walks over, "throw it" and it gets flung. Speech is transcribed by DeepSeek's official ASR and parsed into pet actions; recognition reuses the DeepSeek ASR channel built into dsh-pet, authenticating with the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in DSH credentials. This plugin stores and forwards no keys. dsh-pet must be installed and enabled first.
